verdict.rationale: Extend ships a Parse API whose output is organized into `chunks` with a `metadata` object, and its parsing docs cover figures, charts, equations, tables, and agentic OCR. That implies some structural, layout-aware output, but nothing explicitly documents heading or section hierarchy or reading-order preservation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of heading/section hierarchy in parse output, reading-order guarantees, markdown or structured-tree output format details, independent or hands-on corroboration of structure fidelity.
